instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: Stage 2 synthesis: A severely malnourished post-operative client has had PN started after about five weeks of negligible intake. Within 30 hours, phosphorus has fallen from 2.8 to 1.8 to 1.3 mg/dL, potassium from 3.5 to 3.1 to 2.9 mEq/L, and magnesium from 1.8 to 1.4 to 1.3 mg/dL. The client is lethargic with proximal weakness, shallow respirations, palpitations, frequent PVCs, prolonged QT interval, and glucose 226 mg/dL. The PICC site has erythema, tenderness, and small purulent drainage. Complete the bow-tie diagram.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Administer aggressive potassium, phosphate, and magnesium replacement with telemetry

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Reduce the TPN infusion rate by 50% as ordered

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Independently discontinue TPN abruptly without dextrose backup

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Give aggressive insulin first for glucose 226 mg/dL

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Serum glucose alone as the primary outcome

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Cardiac rhythm, PVCs, and QT interval on telemetry

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: White blood cell count as the main marker of this crisis

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Serum phosphorus, potassium, and magnesium trends
